document.title: SBA 7(a) and 504 Monthly and Yearly Activity Report
document.publisher: U.S. Small Business Administration, Office of Capital Access
document.exclusions: Loan approvals as recorded on the edition's as-of date; the publisher replaces this file every month and earlier months can change

level: 2 — attested restatement of an official publication; not computed by FinanceRateCalc
not_comparable_with: loans disbursed or outstanding (an approval is not a disbursement)
any figure for another SBA program (microloans, disaster loans)
does_not_establish: the number or amount of loans actually disbursed (these are approvals)
that the figure has not changed since this edition (the publisher overwrites the file each month; check the latest edition and the revision ledger)
quoting_rule: Keep the program (7(a) or 504), the approval month, the word 'approved' and the edition's as-of date with the figure. It is an approval count or amount as recorded on that date: do not present it as loans disbursed, as a lender figure, or as anyone's chance of approval. The publisher replaces the file monthly and earlier months can change; if revision_status says a later edition printed a different value, say so.

prior_edition_check.note: Every month in the sheet is compared with the same month in the previous edition on file. Only changed figures and the receipted month are listed; 'compared' and 'changed' count all of them. The publisher overwrites the file, so the previous edition survives only as the archived copy named in that edition's record.
